007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Team;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
012
013/** Enables an existing Select AI team owned by the connected database user. */
014public final class EnableTeamSample {
015
016    private EnableTeamSample() {
017    }
018
019    /**
020     * Loads and enables the named team.
021     *
022     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
023     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
024     */
025    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
026        String teamName = AgentLifecycleSampleSupport.requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_NAME");
027        try (SelectAIAgent client = AgentLifecycleSampleSupport.createClient()) {
028            Team team = client.team(teamName);
029            System.out.printf("Enable team '%s' completed: %s%n", teamName, team.enable());
030        }
031    }
032}
